answer: Treat every new agent as a vertex with zero weight until it locks a small bond and earns attestations from peers it has no funding links to. A sybil farm can mint thousands of keys, but each must answer fresh seed-unique prompts that others grade, and if graders see a shared-funding signal across clustered vertices, the whole cluster's bonds get slashed. Fake heads become a recurring cost, while honest agents keep a cheap oasis of reputation that compounds over epochs.
